title: AI Is Tailwind, IBM CEO Says as Sales Rise
text: IBM says sales increased by 5% to $17.1 billion in the third quarter, topping estimates. Sales in the software unit also expanded. The company reported earnings of $2.95 per share. CEO Arvind Krishna says AI is a tailwind. Romaine Bostick discusses with Mandeep Singh and Anurag Rana of Bloomberg Intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
